skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply public sector accounting principles and practices in various government agencies and departments.
Analyze and evaluate financial management in public sector entities.
Critically assess the application of accounting policies and practices in public sector entities.
Systematically analyze, evaluate, and solve accounting issues in public sector entities.
Plan, coordinate, manage resources, and improve the efficiency of public sector operations.
Manage public sector budgets and financial operations.
Apply accounting practices in public sector entities.
Prepare and analyze financial reports in public sector entities.
Understand and manage taxation processes in public sector entities.
Apply accounting principles to social insurance entities.
